descriptor.name: Erie County Office of GIS tax parcels
descriptor.scope: Erie County tax-parcel polygon service linked by the City of Buffalo; bounded local qualification only. Buffalo municipal completeness is unverified.
descriptor.licenceNote: County publishes tax parcel GIS data for free; redistribution terms and legal survey accuracy remain unverified.
caveats: OBJECTID is the service-native identity; continuity across future service republishes is unverified.
The county website identifies the parcel layer as current to 2025; individual parcel currency and citywide completeness are unverified.

evidence: Frozen packet officialSources and registryBasis identify Erie County Office of GIS as tax-parcel custodian. https://www3.erie.gov/gis/internet-mapping explicitly describes searching tax parcel data and identifies the county PARCELS layer as current to 2025.

Frozen packet and live first-party https://www.buffalony.gov/543/GIS-Maps link the City of Buffalo Online Mapping Parcel Viewer and Erie County Online Mapping System, establishing city relevance without asserting municipal completeness.

https://gis.erie.gov/server/rest/services/OGIS/Parcels/MapServer/0?f=pjson describes Erie County Parcels with esriGeometryPolygon, native OBJECTID and anonymous Query capability; frozen geometry and exact WUP-point observations use that same endpoint.
